dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderate concave curvature on the posterior trailing edge, forming a distinct sickle-shaped spline from the ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute vertex with a small pixel radius, creating a sharply pointed highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 50 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis along the anterior margin.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.3:1 ratio of base width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Large radius convexity creating a bulbous, blunt anterior-dorsal cranial profile.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, stubby beak extension with a high thickness-to-length ratio visible at the anterior tip.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Approximately 140 degrees at the pixel transition between the steep melon slope and the short rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive distribution of white linear and circular depigmentation (scarring) across the dorsal and lateral surfaces; distinct dark marking visible below the eye region.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced vertical crease visible in the center of the melon and a unique blunt, squared-off cranial morphology.
